title: LOB-ID: Evaluating Synthetic Market Data by Inception Distances
abstract: arXiv:2608.13082v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models of limit orderbook (LOB) data have advanced rapidly, but their evaluation often focuses on stylised facts and selected market statistics. These measures provide useful diagnostics but may not capture the joint temporal and cross-level structure of order-book trajectories. We introduce LOB-ID, an embedding-based framework that adapts the Fr\'echet Inception Distance (FID) and Monge Inception Distance (MIND) to LOB data. To obtain domain-specific embeddings, we train the DeepLOB architecture on four months of Level-2 order-book data for five equities. We show that LOB-ID is stable across time, instruments, and embedding checkpoints, and rises monotonically under controlled distortions. We then construct a moment-matching attack against FID and a deep-book perturbation that evades statistic-based evaluation. MIND remains substantially more sensitive to both distortions. translated_title: LOB-ID：通过初始距离评估合成市场数据
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13082v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：限价订单簿（LOB）数据的生成模型发展迅速，但其评估往往侧重于典型化事实和选定的市场统计数据。这些度量提供了有用的诊断信息，但可能无法捕捉订单簿轨迹的联合时间结构和跨层级结构。我们引入了LOB-ID，一种基于嵌入的框架，将弗雷歇初始距离（FID）和蒙古初始距离（MIND）适应于LOB数据。为了获得领域特定的嵌入，我们在五只股票的四个Level-2订单簿数据上训练了DeepLOB架构。我们证明LOB-ID在时间、工具和嵌入检查点方面保持稳定，并在受控失真下单调增加。然后，我们构建了一种针对FID的矩匹配攻击和一种规避基于统计评估的深度账簿扰动。MIND对这两种失真都保持了显著更高的敏感性。最后，我们对五种生成式LOB模型进行了评分，涵盖各种架构。
tldr: 该论文提出了LOB-ID，一种基于嵌入的评估框架，通过适应FID和MIND指标，实现对合成限价订单簿数据的稳健评估，并能检测出传统统计方法无法捕捉的失真。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LOB-ID, an embedding-based evaluation framework that adapts FID and MIND metrics to limit order book data, providing robust assessment of synthetic LOB models and detecting distortions that evade statistical measures.
